title: RangeSlider ignores min / max boundaries
body:
If you set boundaries on a `RangeSlider` widget, there are ignored. In the given example the boundaries are set to `2` and `4`. The UI is align with the options but in the response we still have the movies with a rating greater than `4`.

The boundaries are also ignored when we change the current values of the slider, then reset to the initial state. For example set the slider minimum to `3`, reset it, make a research for `Bad Moon` and you will have some movies with rating lower than `2`.

https://jsfiddle.net/tksyn43f/
